C1056.title: Two Men in Dushan Sentenced for Setting Up Communication Devices to Facilitate Telecom Fraud
C1056.summary: He Mouwen and Luo Mouchang used personal phones and audio adapter cables in dormitories and hotels to set up unauthorized communication equipment, providing support for upstream callers to conduct fraud. Their unauthorized connection and use of personal devices for illegal transmissions led to 10 victims losing over 510,000 yuan, resulting in convictions for aiding information network criminal act
